statBlock.name: Cockatrice
statBlock.description: This skittish, bat-winged bird rushes perceived threats. A bite can turn its victim to stone.

sections.Actions: Bite. Melee weapon attack, +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. A hit deals 3 (1d4 + 1) piercing damage and requires a DC 11 Constitution save against magical petrification. On a failure the target begins to turn to stone and becomes Restrained. It repeats the save at the end of its next turn. A success ends the effect. On a second failure, it is Petrified for 24 hours.

statBlock.name: Flameskull
statBlock.description: The floating skull of a dead wizard. It obeys its creator’s orders literally and can reform after it is destroyed.

sections.Condition immunities: Charmed, Frightened, Paralyzed, Poisoned, and Prone.
sections.Traits:
Illumination. It sheds either dim light out to 15 ft., or bright light out to 15 ft. with dim light for the next 15 ft. Switching between the two takes an action.
Magic Resistance. It makes saves against spells and other magical effects with advantage.
Rejuvenation. One hour after its destruction, it reforms at full HP. Sprinkling Holy Water on the remains or casting Dispel Magic or Remove Curse on them prevents its return. If it reforms but can no longer carry out its orders, it acts independently.
Undead Nature. It needs no air, food, drink, or sleep.
sections.Spellcasting:
5th-level wizard, Intelligence spellcasting, save DC 13 and +5 to hit with spell attacks. It casts without somatic or material components.
Cantrip, at will. Mage Hand.
1st level, 3 slots. Magic Missile, Shield.
2nd level, 2 slots. Blur, Flaming Sphere.
3rd level, 1 slot. Fireball.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Use Fire Ray twice.
Fire Ray. Ranged spell attack, +5 to hit, range 30 ft., one target. Hit 10 (3d6) fire damage.
sections.Printed source: Monster Manual (2014), p. 134. The official errata adds hover and immunity to Prone.

statBlock.name: Gorgon
statBlock.description: An iron-plated bull that tramples prey and breathes green vapor that turns creatures to stone.

sections.Traits: Trampling Charge. If it moves at least 20 ft. straight toward a creature and hits that creature with Gore on the same turn, the target must pass a DC 16 Strength save or fall Prone. If the target is Prone, the gorgon can follow up with one Hooves attack against it as a bonus action.
sections.Actions:
Gore. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 18 (2d12 + 5) piercing damage.
Hooves. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 16 (2d10 + 5) bludgeoning damage.
Petrifying Breath (Recharge 5–6). Creatures in a 30-ft. cone make a DC 13 Constitution save. On a failure a creature begins turning to stone and becomes Restrained. It repeats the save at the end of its next turn. A success ends the effect. A second failure leaves it Petrified until Greater Restoration or other magic frees it.

statBlock.name: Homunculus
statBlock.description: A tiny construct made from clay, ash, mandrake root, and blood. It can scout and share what it senses with its creator.

sections.Languages: Understands its creator’s languages. It cannot speak.
sections.Traits:
Telepathic Bond. As long as it and its creator are on the same plane, they can talk telepathically and the homunculus can magically share what it senses over any distance.
Shared Mind. It knows what its creator knows, including the languages the creator speaks and reads.
Creation. A creator can have only one homunculus. Attempts to make another while the first lives fail. The homunculus dies when its creator dies.
sections.Actions: Bite. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. A hit deals 1 piercing damage and requires a DC 10 Constitution save. On a failure, the target is Poisoned for 1 minute. On a failure by 5 or more, the poison instead lasts 5 (1d10) minutes and the target is Unconscious while affected by it.

statBlock.name: Manticore
statBlock.description: A winged lion with a humanoid face and a tail full of spikes. It often attacks from the air before closing in.

sections.Traits: Tail Spike Regrowth. The manticore starts with 24 tail spikes. Expended spikes return when it finishes a long rest.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite and two Claw attacks, or three Tail Spike attacks.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage.
Claw. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 6 (1d6 + 3) slashing damage.
Tail Spike. Ranged weapon attack, +5 to hit, range 100/200 ft., one target. Hit 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage.

statBlock.name: Spectator
statBlock.description: Beholder kin with four eyestalks, summoned as a guard. A spectator usually speaks telepathically and can turn hostile spells on nearby creatures.

sections.Languages: Deep Speech and Undercommon. Telepathy 120 ft.
sections.Summoning and service: A summoning ritual consumes four beholder eyestalks. The spectator guards an item or location chosen by its summoner for 101 years. It grants access only to the summoner unless instructed otherwise. If its guarded item is stolen or destroyed before that time runs out, the spectator vanishes. Once its term is up, it is free to leave.
sections.Actions:
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +1 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 2 (1d6 − 1) piercing damage.
Eye Rays. Use up to two different magical rays, targeting one or two creatures the spectator can see within 90 ft. Each ray is limited to one use per turn.
Confusion Ray. On a failed DC 13 Wisdom save, the target loses its reactions until the end of its next turn. On that turn it cannot move, and it spends its action making a melee or ranged attack against a randomly selected creature within reach or range. If unable to attack, it does nothing that turn.
Paralyzing Ray. On a failed DC 13 Constitution save, the target is Paralyzed for 1 minute. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the paralysis on a success.
Fear Ray. On a failed DC 13 Wisdom save, the target is Frightened for 1 minute. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns to end the fear. It has disadvantage on the repeat save if it can see the spectator.
Wounding Ray. The target makes a DC 13 Constitution save. It takes 16 (3d10) necrotic damage on a failure, or half on a success.
Create Food and Water. Conjure enough food and water for the spectator to live on for 24 hours.
sections.Reactions: Spell Reflection. When it succeeds on a save against a spell or a spell attack misses it, the spectator can redirect the spell to another creature it can see within 30 ft., including the caster. The new target takes the spectator’s place as the target and rolls its own save if the spell calls for one. If the spell was an attack, reroll the attack against the new target.

statBlock.name: Worg
statBlock.description: A cunning, speaking predator sometimes ridden by goblins or hobgoblins. A mistreated mount may turn on its rider.

sections.Traits: Keen Hearing and Smell. It makes Wisdom (Perception) checks based on hearing or smell with advantage.
sections.Actions: Bite. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 10 (2d6 + 3) piercing damage. A creature hit by the bite must pass a DC 13 Strength save or fall Prone.
